claims.statement: For every binary s-by-m matrix M of rank m-2, every affine phase, and every Boolean D(y), P(x,y)=(-1)^(x^TMy+affine)D(y) satisfies H(P)<=2I(P) and U(P)<=2I(P) in the original physical basis.
For the same P, every finite adaptive/pruned physical restriction tree and every common disjoint Boolean terminal core h have complete retained-U loss at most 2I(P).

quantifiers.tree: every finite deterministic adaptive/pruned tree on P variables
quantifiers.terminal_core: every Boolean h on a disjoint block
quantifiers.leaf_probabilities: all dyadic probabilities induced by uniform restrictions

claims.statement: The constant two is sharp for this class, already for rank zero and a nonaffine Boolean function on two bits.
